**Answer**

- **How the value is supplied at assembly:** The distribution passes `--application-version <string>` to `openmrs assemble`. The CLI option is defined in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts` (lines 345-350) and forwarded as `applicationVersion` (line 368). `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.ts` (lines 392-404) writes it as the top-level `version` of `routes.registry.json`, and omits it when the value is missing, null, or blank. The option is also documented in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md` (line 166).
- **Where it is shown by default:** The app shell reads `initialRouteMap.version` and exposes it as `window.applicationVersion` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts`, lines 104-124). The sign-in page renders it at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login/login.component.tsx` line 258, and the primary navigation bar renders it at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/components/navbar/navbar.component.tsx` line 65. Both render only when the value is truthy.
- **When nobody set it:** `run.ts` sets `window.applicationVersion` to `undefined`, so nothing is shown on the sign-in page or the navbar. The "Prerelease" text is not a default. It appears only when the distribution explicitly passes `prerelease`. In that case the shell shows the translated `localVersion` when `spaVersion` is `local`, and `prereleaseVersion` otherwise (`run.ts` lines 111-117; `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-translations/translations/en.json` line 69).
- **Change that added it:** Commit `9f0c6aa831f37ffcaf167a7096b07ec3e96a0431` ("(feat) Add a distribution-controlled version property (#1815)", by Ian, 2026-08-21), from PR #1815 in openmrs-esm-core. I found no ticket linked to it. The commit message, the PR's stored links, and the PR body contain no O3-xxxx key; the PR body's ticket link is an empty placeholder.

**Discrepancy:** PR #1815's description says the flag is `--openmrs-version` and that an unset version reads "Prerelease". The code as merged uses `--application-version`, and an unset version shows nothing. I followed the code.
